Notices your organizations sent you: list them, mark them read, archive them, choose how they reach
you.

Usage:
  voidhash notices <command> [flags]

Aliases:
  notices, notice

Commands:
  list         List the notices an organization sent you, newest first.
  read         Mark notices read, or the whole inbox with --all.
  archive      Archive notices, which also marks them read.
  unarchive    Bring archived notices back to the inbox.
  preferences  Show or change how each category of notices reaches you, and their language.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash notices <command> --help' for more about a command.
